Class CharacterCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.model.cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.model.cards.deckCards.DeckCard
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.model.cards.deckCards.CharacterCard
Direct Known Subclasses:
Artist, Builder, Gatherer, Hunter, Inventor, Shaman
public abstract class CharacterCard extends DeckCard
Represents an abstract Character card within the game deck.

This class serves as the base layer for all specific character card types (such as Artists or Builders). It defines common game rules for characters, such as their default availability to be picked and how they interact with the game Board during the setup and discarding phases.

    • CharacterCard

      public CharacterCard(int age, int id)
      Constructs a new CharacterCard with the specified age and unique identifier. This constructor is designed to be invoked by concrete subclasses during JSON deserialization.
      Parameters:
      age - the historical age/era this card belongs to (passed to super)
      id - the unique identifier of the card (passed to super)

  • Method Details

    • isPickable

      public boolean isPickable(Player player)
      Determines whether this character card can be picked by a player.

      By default, character cards do not have resource prerequisites or upfront food costs, meaning they are always available to be picked.

      Specified by:
      isPickable in class Card
      Parameters:
      player - the Player attempting to pick the card
      Returns:
      always true as character cards have no picking restrictions

    • discard

      public void discard(Board board, int cardIndex)
      Handles the discarding process of this character card from the board.

      Removes the card from the bottom deckable row of the specified game board using its grid or list index.

      Specified by:
      discard in class DeckCard
      Parameters:
      board - the Board instance from which the card is discarded
      cardIndex - the index position of the card within the row

    • setupPhaseFour

      public int setupPhaseFour(Board board)
      Executes the specific setup actions required for character cards during "Phase Four" of the game initialization.

      Places this card instance into the bottom deckable row of the board and returns the count of cards added.

      Specified by:
      setupPhaseFour in class DeckCard
      Parameters:
      board - the Board being initialized
      Returns:
      the number of cards successfully added to the row (always 1)
